Persons with a nationality outside the European Union (EU) and the European Economic Area (EEA).
If you are interested in applying to our university, choose what you aim to study and apply directly to DIT via our own online application portal, Primuss.

If you are interested in studying at the Deggendorf Institute of Technology as an international bachelor student, you need a ‘’university entrance qualification’’ as one of the admission requirements. This is your school-leaving certificate which qualifies you to study bachelor programmes at German universities.
Language requirements German A1 (to be submitted by March 14 at the latest)

Language requirements German A1 (to be submitted by March 14 at the latest) English B2 (e.g. certificate from the educational institution that courses and examinations were held exclusively in English)
